caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron gate in the foreground, featuring decorative scrollwork and circular ornaments. Above the gate, there is an iron cross with radiating lines attached to the front. Behind the gate, a stone tomb or mausoleum is visible, which has a decorative frieze with floral motifs near the top edge. On top of the tomb, there is a sculpted stone cross. The entire composition is rendered in shades of brown and gray in a monotone style, giving the appearance of a sepia-toned image. The background is plain and unadorned, placing emphasis on the architectural and decorative elements.
title: Cross
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
